title: [WIP] Investigate large size of packaged components
body:
## Bundle Size Reduction Plan

- [x] Analyze current bundle size (1.35MB UMD, 1.77MB ESM)
- [x] Identify issue: all dependencies were being bundled instead of externalized
- [x] Update vite.config.ts to externalize:
  - Workspace dependencies (@object-ui/*)
  - All Radix UI dependencies
  - Other heavy dependencies (lucide-react, date-fns, etc.)
- [x] Add bundle analyzer (rollup-plugin-visualizer)
- [x] Rebuild and verify reduction (199KB UMD, 279KB ESM - 85% reduction!)
- [x] Optimize plugin packages:
  - plugin-charts: externalize recharts (8.8KB UMD)
  - plugin-editor: externalize @monaco-editor/react (2.1KB UMD)
  - plugin-kanban: externalize @dnd-kit/* (5.6KB UMD)
  - plugin-markdown: externalize react-markdown, remark-gfm, rehype-sanitize (2.6KB UMD)
- [x] Run tests to ensure everything still works
- [x] Document the change in README and BUNDLE_SIZE_OPTIMIZATION.md
